item.text: The log spans June through August 2026. I’m applying merchant-based categories and checking for exact repeats; ambiguous transfers and cash withdrawals will stay uncategorized, and the REI return will reduce that category’s spending.

"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command "@'
import re, datetime, collections
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('personal_expenses.txt')
lines=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').splitlines()
pat=re.compile(r'"'^'"\\s*-?\\s*(.*?)(?:\\s+[-|:]\\s+|,\\s*)(.*?)\\s*\\"'$?(-?'"\\d+\\.\\d{2})\\s*"'$'"')
# date parser and merchant/date orientation helpers
months={'january':1,'jan':1,'february':2,'feb':2,'march':3,'mar':3,'april':4,'apr':4,'may':5,'june':6,'jun':6,'july':7,'jul':7,'august':8,'aug':8,'sep':9,'september':9,'oct':10,'october':10,'nov':11,'november':11,'dec':12,'december':12}
def parse_date(s):
 s=s.strip().strip('()')
 for fmt in ('%Y-%m-%d','%m-%d-%y','%m-%d','%m/%d/%y','%m/%d'):
  try:
   d=datetime.datetime.strptime(s,fmt).date()
   return d.replace(year=2026) if d.year==1900 else d
  except: pass
 m=re.fullmatch(r'([A-Za-z]+)\\.?\\s+(\\d{1,2})(?:,?\\s*(\\d{4}|\\d{2}))?',s)
 if m and m.group(1).lower()[:3] in months:
  return datetime.date(int(m.group(3)) if m.group(3) and len(m.group(3))==4 else 2026,months[m.group(1).lower()[:3]],int(m.group(2)))
 return None
def categor(merchant):
 m=merchant.lower()
 if any(x in m for x in ['coffee','starbucks','bagel','chipotle','mcdonald','panera','brewery','sushi','thai orchid','luigi','pizza']): return 'Eating out / coffee'
 if any(x in m for x in ['amazon','target','best buy','home depot','rei','old navy','ikea','barnes & noble','ticketmaster','spotify concert','amc theatres','bowl-o-rama']): return 'Shopping / entertainment'
 if any(x in m for x in ['trader joe','aldi','kroger','whole foods','costco']): return 'Groceries'
 if any(x in m for x in ['shell','chevron','bp gas','jiffy lube']): return 'Transportation: fuel/auto'
 if any(x in m for x in ['city parking','airport parking','uber','lyft','delta air','hertz']): return 'Transportation: travel'
 if any(x in m for x in ['netflix','icloud','xfinity','spotify premium','verizon','planet fitness']): return 'Bills / subscriptions'
 if any(x in m for x in ['walgreens','cvs','dental','physical therapy']): return 'Health / pharmacy'
 return 'Uncategorized'
records=[]; bad=[]
for n,line in enumerate(lines,1):
 if not line.strip() or line.strip().lower().startswith('misc') or line.strip().startswith('('): continue
 # Identify amount as final number, then peel date and merchant from remainder
 am=re.search(r'(-?\\"'$?'"\\d+\\.\\d{2})\\s*"'$'"',line)
 if not am: bad.append((n,line)); continue
 amount=float(am.group(1).replace('"'$'"','')); left=line[:am.start()].strip(' -|:,')
 # locate date in prefix/suffix
 date=None; merchant=''
 # date at beginning
 for patdate in [r'"'^('"\\d{4}-\\d{1,2}-\\d{1,2})\\s*[-|:]?\\s*(.*)"'$'"',r'"'^('"\\d{1,2}[/-]\\d{1,2}(?:[/-]\\d{2,4})?)\\s*[-|:]?\\s*(.*)"'$'"',r'"'^([A-Za-z]+'"\\.?\\s+\\d{1,2}(?:,?\\s*\\d{2,4})?)\\s*[-|:]?\\s*(.*)"'$'"']:
  q=re.match(patdate,left)
  if q and parse_date(q.group(1)): date=parse_date(q.group(1)); merchant=q.group(2).strip(' -|:,'); break
 if date is None:
  # date at end, often parenthesized
  for patdate in [r'(.*?)\\s*\\((\\d{4}-\\d{1,2}-\\d{1,2}|\\d{1,2}[/-]\\d{1,2}(?:[/-]\\d{2,4})?|[A-Za-z]+\\.?\\s+\\d{1,2}(?:,?\\s*\\d{2,4})?)\\)"'$'"',r'(.*?)\\s+([A-Za-z]+\\.?\\s+\\d{1,2}(?:,?\\s*\\d{2,4})?)"'$'"']:
   q=re.match(patdate,left)
   if q and parse_date(q.group(2)): merchant=q.group(1).strip(' -|:,'); date=parse_date(q.group(2)); break
 if date is None: bad.append((n,line)); continue
 merchant=re.sub(r'"'^'"\\((.*)\\)"'$'"',r'\\1',merchant).strip()
 # handle pipe/date/merchant pattern and unusual merchant then comma date patterns
 merchant=merchant.strip(' -|:,')
 if not merchant: bad.append((n,line)); continue
 records.append((n,date,merchant,amount,categor(merchant)))
# report parse and duplicates
print('TRANSACTIONS',len(records),'UNPARSED',len(bad)); print('BAD',bad)
seen={}; dup=[]
for r in records:
 key=(r[1],r[2].lower(),r[3])
 if key in seen: dup.append((r,seen[key]))
 else: seen[key]=r
print('DUPLICATES',dup)
# exact repeat remove later duplicate
clean=[r for r in records if not any(r[0]==d[0][0] for d in dup)]
monthly=collections.defaultdict(float)
for n,d,m,a,c in clean: monthly[(d.strftime('%Y-%m'),c)]+=a
cats=sorted(set(c for _,_,_,_,c in clean)); mons=sorted(set(d.strftime('%Y-%m') for _,d,_,_,_ in clean))
print('CATEGORIES',cats)
for mo in mons: print(mo, ' | '.join(f'{c}={monthly[(mo,c)]:.2f}' for c in cats if monthly[(mo,c)]))
print('UNCAT',[r for r in clean if r[4]=='Uncategorized'])
'@ | python -"
